modifications: Filtered to real object types, mag <= 14 (or no magnitude, for non-galaxies) and size >= 1 arcmin plus every Messier, Caldwell and named object; fields renamed; duplicate (Dup) designations folded into the aliases of the object they duplicate; surface brightness computed from magnitude and size where the source has none (sbComputed).
